topic: Data structure for face analytics import
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on the structure required to import face analytics data, provided in a CSV format. The raw data sample included multiple identifiers (Frame ID, Face ID, Construction ID, etc.) and various counts/metrics related to different categories of people (VAC, ROTS, GRP). It was noted that the current field names might not accurately reflect which metrics correspond to which face IDs.

The next steps involve having someone who has seen the data previously (Galina) review the provided file structure to determine the correct mapping and required fields for import.
decisions: The raw CSV data sample was shared for structural review.
action_items: Someone needs to consult Galina regarding the specific data requirements and field mappings for the face analytics export file.
